task.title: P6-027: [parked] Fix the @fast tiers real data race across parallel workers
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-027. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**The `@fast` tier has a real data race, not only the known hydration flake.** An 8-worker run showed 8 failures across `command-palette`/`needs`/`selection-tray`; all 30 of those specs passed serially. The tree-move spec's DB writes race the palette and needs specs' tree *reads* on the shared seeded e2e user, so the suite shares mutable fixture state across workers — fixing hydration (`P6-060`) alone will **not** make it parallel-safe. `playwright.config.ts` still defaults to parallel workers locally, and this is recorded nowhere in `ui-work-loop.md`.

**Trigger: before parallel workers are re-enabled.** First step is a Finding, not a fix.
